description: List payouts (disbursements) with optional filters. Returns a paginated slice — use starting_after / ending_before cursors. Handy for reconciliation of seller/creator settlement runs.

ending_before.description: Cursor — return items before this payout id (payout_xxx)

starting_after.description: Cursor — return items after this payout id (payout_xxx)

status.description: Filter by payout status (Created / Confirmed / Completed / Error / Cancelled)

name: list_payouts
